name: Lena Kirishima
want: find the friend she made a promise to when she was seven, and fit back into Japan
secret: Her Japanese reading is still at a primary-school level after eight years abroad, and she is terrified of failing the exams.
voice: Mixes English words in, trips over things, laughs it off, says exactly what she thinks.
description: Left Mito at seven when her father was posted to London; comes back for the second term and lives in the dorm.
appearance: Light brown hair in a messy bun, a London Underground keyring, plasters on both knees.

agenda.goal: find her childhood friend and remind them of their promise
steps: trips over her own feet in front of the whole class on her first day

steps.text: finds the player at lunch and asks if they remember the promise under the plum tree at Kairakuen

steps: asks Kazuha Minase to help her with her kanji homework in the dorm
